data.description: Create a synthetic corpus generator that can create documents with: controllable size (chars), controllable vocabulary overlap, controllable concept density. Essential for reproducible benchmarks that don't depend on samples/ directory.

properties.retrospective: Implemented SyntheticCorpusGenerator in benchmarks/corpus/base.py with SyntheticCorpusConfig dataclass. Features: controllable n_docs, doc_length, vocab_size, concept_count, concept_frequency, code_style, seed for reproducibility. Includes generate() and generate_with_queries() methods.

data.title: Implement synthetic corpus generator for benchmarks
